# Relm Full Documentation & Reference Manual

> A modular Elm-architecture (Model-View-Update + Side Effects) state management and UI framework for Clojure and ClojureScript on top of [Replicant](https://github.com/cjohansen/replicant).

---

## 1. Architecture & Mental Model

### The Elm Architecture on Replicant

Relm adapts the Model-View-Update (MVU) pattern to ClojureScript, paired with the high-performance data-driven DOM library [Replicant](https://github.com/cjohansen/replicant).

```
                      +--------------------------------+
                      |         DOM User Event         |
                      +--------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
                      +--------------------------------+
                      |      relm/dispatch! [msg]      |
                      +--------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
                      +--------------------------------+
                      |          relm/update           |
                      |   [state context msg event]    |
                      +--------------------------------+
                         /            |             \
                        /             |              \
                       v              v               v
                +-----------+  +-------------+  +-------------+
                | new-state |  | new-context |  |   effects   |
                +-----------+  +-------------+  +-------------+
                      |               |                |
                      +-------+-------+                v
                              |                 +-------------+
                              v                 |   relm/fx   |
                      +----------------+        +-------------+
                      |  Re-render DOM |               |
                      |  (Replicant)   |               v
                      +----------------+        (Async Follow-up Msg)
```

1. **Model**:
   - **Local State** (`state`): Encapsulated component instance state (e.g. form inputs, UI toggles, accordion open/close).
   - **Global Context** (`context`): Cross-cutting shared application data (e.g. active route, user auth, server-state caches, theme).
2. **View**: Pure function `(fn [state context] hiccup)` that returns pure Clojure Hiccup vectors. No derefs, subscriptions, or side effects are embedded in view rendering.
3. **Update**: Pure multimethod `(update state context message event)` returning `[new-state new-context effects]`.
4. **Side Effects**: Open multimethod `(fx event effect)` executing side effects linearly. Effects can dispatch follow-up messages to the runtime.

### State Model: Local State vs Global Context

Relm stores runtime state in a single atom (`relm.core/!app-state`) structured as:

```clojure
{:context    {;; Global data accessible to all views and updates
              :current-route :dashboard
              :queries       {[:posts] {:data [...] :status :success}}
              :auth-user     {:id 101 :name "Alice"}}

 :components {"counter-1"   {:state {:count 5}}
              "form-profile" {:state {:form {...}}}}

 :root       {:node       #object[HTMLBodyElement]
              :component  AppRootComponent
              :args       {...}}}
```

- When an update message is dispatched from a component, `relm.core` looks up that component's local state by ID, executes `relm/update`, saves the updated local state into `:components`, updates `:context`, executes returned `effects`, and batches a DOM re-render.

### Rendering Pipeline & Life of a Message

1. **User interaction** triggers an event handler defined in Hiccup: `[:button {:on {:click [::increment]}} "+1"]`.
2. Replicant dispatches the event vector via `(r/set-dispatch! relm/dispatch!)`.
3. `relm/dispatch!` identifies the calling component's instance ID from event metadata or dynamic render scope.
4. `relm/update` multimethod computes `[new-state new-context effects]`.
5. Local state and global context are updated in `!app-state`.
6. Side-effects in `effects` vector are executed via `relm/fx`.
7. `flush-render!` renders the root component with Replicant on the next animation frame (or microtask), updating only changed DOM nodes.

### Comparison: Relm vs re-frame vs Elm

| Feature / Dimension | Relm | re-frame | Elm |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **View Functions** | Pure functions `(fn [state context] hiccup)` | Reagent components dereferencing `RAtom`s | Pure functions `(fn [model] Html Msg)` |
| **DOM Engine** | [Replicant](https://github.com/cjohansen/replicant) (VDOM from pure data) | React (via Reagent) | Elm Virtual DOM |
| **State Structure** | **Hybrid**: Local component state map + Global context map | **Global DB**: Single flat/nested atom `app-db` | **Single Model**: Top-level model tree |
| **Update Mechanism** | Open multimethod `relm/update` | Interceptor registry (`reg-event-db`, `reg-event-fx`) | Closed algebraic union type `Msg` |
| **Side Effects** | Open multimethod `relm/fx` with ordered effect vectors | Event effects map `{:fx [...]}` / interceptor chain | Opaque `Cmd` / `Sub` with JavaScript Ports |
| **Dependencies** | Zero React runtime; minimal footprint | React, React DOM, Reagent, re-frame | Elm compiler & standard platform |

## 3. `relm.core` Reference

Namespace: `relm.core`

### Component Definition (`relm/component`)

Components are created with `(relm/component config-map)`.

#### Configuration Map Options

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `:view` | `(fn [state context] hiccup)` | **Yes** | Pure view function returning Replicant Hiccup. |
| `:init` | `(fn [context args] initial-state)` | No | Pure initialization function returning initial local state. Defaults to `(constantly {})`. |
| `:on-init` | `(fn [state context args event] [state context effects])` | No | Lifecycle hook executed when the component initializes/mounts. |
| `:on-deinit` | `(fn [state context args event] [state context effects])` | No | Lifecycle hook executed when the component is unmounted. |
| `:component-id` | `string \| keyword` | No | Explicit base identifier for the component. |

```clojure
(ns my-app.counter
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]))

(defn init [_context {:keys [start] :or {start 0}}]
  {:count start})

(defn on-init [state context {:keys [start]} _event]
  [state context [[::relm/dispatch! [::log (str "Initialized counter at " start)]]]])

(defn view [{:keys [count]} _context]
  [:div
   [:p "Count: " count]
   [:button {:on {:click [::increment]}} "+1"]])

(def Counter
  (relm/component
    {:component-id "counter"
     :init         init
     :on-init      on-init
     :view         view}))
```

### Component Lifecycle Hooks

- `on-init`: Invoked once when the component is mounted. Supports arities 0 to 4: `(fn [] ...)`, `(fn [state] ...)`, `(fn [state context] ...)`, `(fn [state context args] ...)`, or `(fn [state context args event] ...)`.
- `on-deinit`: Invoked when component is unmounted or clean up message is received. Returns `[state context effects]`.

### Mounting and Rendering

```clojure
(require '[relm.core :as relm]
         '[replicant.dom :as r])

;; 1. Configure Replicant dispatcher
(r/set-dispatch! relm/dispatch!)

;; 2. Mount root component into DOM
(relm/render! (js/document.getElementById "app") Counter {:start 0})
```

- `(relm/render! dom-node component & [args])`: Mounts the root component to `dom-node` and schedules the first render.
- `(relm/flush-render!)`: Synchronously executes any queued animation frame render passes.

### Update Multimethod (`relm/update`)

Handles pure state transitions based on message types.

```clojure
(defmulti update (fn [_state _context message _event] (first message)))
```

#### Return Signatures

Handlers can return:
1. `[new-state new-context]` — Updates state and context with no side-effects.
2. `[new-state new-context effects-vector]` — Updates state, context, and schedules effects.
3. If returning a 2-element vector, effects default to `nil`.

```clojure
(defmethod relm/update ::increment
  [state context [_ amount :as _message] _event]
  [(update state :count (fnil + 0) (or amount 1)) context])

(defmethod relm/update ::fetch-profile
  [state context [_ user-id] _event]
  [(assoc state :loading? true)
   context
   [[::relm.http/fetch!
     {:url        (str "/api/users/" user-id)
      :on-success [::profile-loaded]
      :on-failure [::profile-failed]}]]])
```

### Side-Effect Multimethod (`relm/fx`)

Executes impure operations returned by `update` handlers.

```clojure
(defmulti fx (fn [_event effect] (first effect)))
```

```clojure
(defmethod relm/fx ::log!
  [_event [_ message]]
  (js/console.log "[APP LOG]" message))
```

### Built-in Messages and Effects

#### Core Messages
- `[::relm/init-component initial-state]` or `[::relm/init-component comp-id initial-state]`
- `[::relm/deinit-component comp-id]`
- `[::relm/send target-comp-id messages]` — Delivers message(s) to a specific component's local state.

#### Core Side Effects
- `[::relm/dispatch! msg-or-batch]` — Dispatches message(s) to the runtime.
- `[::relm/dispatch-later! [{:ms 100 :dispatch! [::msg]}]]` — Dispatches messages after a delay via `js/setTimeout`.
- `[::relm/dispatch-n! [[::msg-1] [::msg-2]]]` — Dispatches multiple messages.

### Inter-Component Messaging & Nested Components

Components can be embedded inside parent view functions:

```clojure
(defn parent-view [state context]
  [:div
   [:h1 "Dashboard"]
   ;; Render child component instance with arguments and optional explicit ID
   [ChildComponent {:id "user-details" :user-id 42}]])
```

To send messages across components, dispatch `::relm/send`:

```clojure
(defmethod relm/update ::refresh-child [state context _ _]
  [state context
   [[::relm/dispatch! [::relm/send "user-details" [::reload]]]]])
```

### Runtime State

`relm.core/!app-state` contains the current context, component states, and root render configuration.
Use it for diagnostics and DevTools integration; application updates should flow through `relm/update`.

### Dispatch Listeners

Register callbacks to intercept all message dispatches (useful for logging, telemetry, or DevTools):

```clojure
(def listener-id
  (relm/add-dispatch-listener!
    (fn [{:keys [component-id message event state context new-state new-context effects]}]
      (js/console.log "Dispatched:" message))))

(relm/remove-dispatch-listener! listener-id)
```

---

## 4. `relm.http` Reference

Namespace: `relm.http`

Provides declarative HTTP request management on top of standard browser Fetch API.

### Fetch Effect (`::relm.http/fetch!`)

Dispatched as `[::relm.http/fetch! request-map]` (or `[::http/fetch! request-map]`).

```clojure
(defmethod relm/update ::save-data [state context [_ payload] _event]
  [state context
   [[::relm.http/fetch!
     {:url             "/api/items"
      :method          :post
      :json-params     payload
      :response-format :json
      :on-success      [::save-success]
      :on-failure      [::save-failure]
      :abort-id        :save-request}]]])
```

### Abort Effect (`::relm.http/abort!`)

Cancels any in-flight request associated with the specified abort key.

```clojure
(defmethod relm/update ::cancel-save [state context _ _]
  [state context [[::relm.http/abort! :save-request]]])
```

### HTTP Configuration Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `:url` | `string` | **Required** | Request URL endpoint. |
| `:method` | `keyword \| string` | `:get` | HTTP method (`:get`, `:post`, `:put`, `:delete`, `:patch`, `:head`, `:options`). |
| `:headers` | `map` | `{}` | HTTP request headers map. |
| `:body` | `string \| js/FormData \| js/Blob` | `nil` | Raw request body. |
| `:json-params` | `any` | `nil` | Clojure data structure converted to JSON string. Sets `Content-Type: application/json`. |
| `:transit-params` | `any` | `nil` | Clojure data structure serialized with Transit JSON. Sets `Content-Type: application/transit+json`. |
| `:params` / `:query-params` | `map` | `nil` | Query parameters serialized to URL query string. |
| `:response-format` | `keyword` | `:json` | Response parsing mode: `:json`, `:transit`, `:text`, `:raw`. |
| `:timeout` | `integer` | `nil` | Request timeout in milliseconds. |
| `:on-success` | `vector` | `nil` | Message vector dispatched on success: `(conj on-success response-map)`. |
| `:on-failure` | `vector` | `nil` | Message vector dispatched on error/status >= 400: `(conj on-failure error-map)`. |
| `:abort-id` | `any` | `nil` | Arbitrary key identifying this request for cancellation via `::abort!`. |
| `:with-credentials?` | `boolean` | `false` | When true, includes cookies in cross-origin requests. |

### Response Format & Error Handling

Success and failure messages receive a response map:

```clojure
{:status       200
 :status-text  "OK"
 :ok?          true
 :headers      {"content-type" "application/json"}
 :body         {:id 1 :title "Hello"}
 :raw-response #object[Response]}
```

---

## 5. `relm.navigation` Reference

Namespace: `relm.navigation`

Provides side effects for HTML5 History manipulation and browser window location changes.

### Navigation Effects

| Effect Vector | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `[::relm.navigation/push-state! state title url]` | Calls `window.history.pushState`. `title` can be `nil`. |
| `[::relm.navigation/push-state! url]` | Convenience 1-arg arity for `pushState`. |
| `[::relm.navigation/replace-state! state title url]` | Calls `window.history.replaceState`. |
| `[::relm.navigation/replace-state! url]` | Convenience 1-arg arity for `replaceState`. |
| `[::relm.navigation/back!]` | Calls `window.history.back()`. |
| `[::relm.navigation/forward!]` | Calls `window.history.forward()`. |
| `[::relm.navigation/go! delta]` | Calls `window.history.go(delta)`. |
| `[::relm.navigation/reload!]` | Calls `window.location.reload()`. |

### Navigation Usage Examples

```clojure
(ns my-app.nav
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.navigation :as nav]))

(defmethod relm/update ::go-to-article [state context [_ article-id] _]
  [state context [[::nav/push-state! (str "/articles/" article-id)]]])

(defmethod relm/update ::history-back [state context _ _]
  [state context [[::nav/back!]]])
```

---

## 6. `relm.form` Reference

Namespace: `relm.form`

`relm.form` is a declarative form management system that maintains form state directly within component local state.

### Form Architecture

Form state is structured within local component state:

```clojure
{:form {:values       {:username "alice" :email "alice@example.com"}
        :initial      {:username "" :email ""}
        :errors       {:email "Invalid email"}
        :touched      #{[:email]}
        :dirty        #{[:username]}
        :submitting?  false
        :submitted?   false
        :submit-count 1
        :validate-on  #{:change :blur :submit}
        :validators   {[:email] [email-validator-fn]}}}
```

### Initialization (`form/create`)

```clojure
(defn init [_context _args]
  {:form (form/create
           {:initial-values {:username "" :email ""}
            :validate-on    #{:change :blur :submit}
            :validators     {:username [(form/required "Username is required")]}})})
```

#### Options for `form/create`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `:initial-values` | `map` | `{}` | Default base values map. |
| `:validate-on` | `set` | `#{:change :blur :submit}` | Set of triggers that execute validation. |
| `:validators` | `map` | `{}` | Map of field paths to validator vectors. |
| `:validate` | `fn` | `nil` | Whole-form validation function `(fn [values] errors-map)`. |
| `:key` / `:form-key`| `keyword \| vector` | `:form` | Key path in component state where form is stored. |

### Field Registration (`form/register`)

`(form/register form path opts)` produces Replicant DOM attributes for input elements:

```clojure
[:input (form/register form :email
          {:type        "email"
           :required    "Email is required"
           :email       "Please enter a valid email address"
           :placeholder "you@domain.com"})]
```

#### Field Registration Options

| Option | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `:type` | `string` | HTML input type (e.g. `"text"`, `"email"`, `"password"`, `"number"`, `"checkbox"`). |
| `:required` | `boolean \| string` | Requires non-empty value. String provides custom error message. |
| `:email` | `boolean \| string` | Validates email address format. |
| `:min-length` | `integer \| [integer string]` | Minimum character length. |
| `:max-length` | `integer \| [integer string]` | Maximum character length. |
| `:min` | `number \| [number string]` | Minimum numeric value. |
| `:max` | `number \| [number string]` | Maximum numeric value. |
| `:pattern` | `regex \| [regex string]` | Regular expression pattern matching. |
| `:one-of` | `coll \| [coll string]` | Value must belong to collection. |
| `:validate` | `fn \| vector` | Custom validator function or sequence of functions. |
| `:default-value`| `any` | Initial value if not provided in `form/create`. |

### Built-in Validation Rules

- `(form/required [msg])`: Value cannot be nil, empty string, or false.
- `(form/email [msg])`: Validates standard email address regex.
- `(form/min-num min-val [msg])`: Validates value >= `min-val`.
- `(form/max-num max-val [msg])`: Validates value <= `max-val`.
- `(form/min-length min-len [msg])`: String or collection length >= `min-len`.
- `(form/max-length max-len [msg])`: String or collection length <= `max-len`.
- `(form/pattern regex [msg])`: Validates against regular expression.
- `(form/one-of coll [msg])`: Value must exist within `coll`.
- `(form/compose & validators)`: Chains multiple validators; returns first error message.

### Custom & Cross-Field Validation

```clojure
;; Custom field validator: (fn [value field-path form-values] (when-not (valid? value) "Error msg"))
(defn match-password [val _path values]
  (when (not= val (:password values))
    "Passwords must match"))

[:input (form/register form :confirm-password
          {:type     "password"
           :validate [match-password]})]
```

### View Query Helpers

- `(form/value form path & [default])`: Retrieves current value at field path.
- `(form/values form)`: Returns entire map of current form values.
- `(form/error form path & [touched-only?])`: Returns error string for field path (optional only if field is touched).
- `(form/errors form)`: Returns map of all validation errors.
- `(form/touched? form path)`: Returns true if field path has been blurred/touched.
- `(form/dirty? form path)`: Returns true if field value differs from its initial value.
- `(form/valid? form)`: Returns true if there are zero validation errors.
- `(form/submitting? form)`: Returns true if submission is in progress.
- `(form/submitted? form)`: Returns true if form was submitted at least once.

### Form State Reducers

- `(form/set-value form path val)`: Sets field value and validates if `:validate-on` includes `:change`.
- `(form/set-touched form path)`: Marks field as touched and validates if `:validate-on` includes `:blur`.
- `(form/set-error form path error-msg)`: Sets explicit validation error for a field.
- `(form/set-submitting form submitting?)`: Toggles form submitting status.
- `(form/reset-form form & [new-initial-values])`: Resets form values, errors, touched, and dirty flags.

### Form Submission & Lifecycle Events

```clojure
[:form (form/form-attrs form
         {:on {:submit [::form/submit form
                        {:on-submit [::submit-success]
                         :on-error  [::submit-failed]}]}})
 ...]
```

- When submitted, `::form/submit` marks all fields as touched, runs all validators, and:
  - If valid: sets `:submitting? true` and dispatches `:on-submit` with the form values.
  - If invalid: sets error states and dispatches `:on-error` (if specified).

---

## 7. `relm.query` Reference

Namespace: `relm.query`

`relm.query` brings TanStack Query-style server-state caching, stale-while-revalidate policies, optimistic mutations, and hierarchical cache invalidation to Relm.

### Server-State Architecture & Context Cache

Server cache lives in Relm's global `context` map:

```clojure
{:queries   {[:posts {:_limit 5}]
             {:data         [{:id 1 :title "Post 1"}]
              :status       :success      ;; :idle | :loading | :success | :error
              :loading?     false
              :fetching?    false
              :stale?       false
              :updated-at   1700000000000
              :error        nil
              :error-count  0
              :options      {...}}}

 :mutations {[:posts]
             {:status   :loading          ;; :idle | :loading | :success | :error
              :loading? true
              :data     nil
              :error    nil}}}
```

### Vector Query Keys & Request Helpers

Query keys are arbitrary vectors: `[:posts]`, `[:posts {:_limit 5}]`, `[:users 10 :todos]`.

- `(query/key->url key)`: Translates key vector to URL path and query string.
  - Example: `[:posts {:_limit 5}]` -> `"/posts?_limit=5"`
- `(query/key->opts key & [extra-opts])`: Converts query key into full HTTP options map.
  - Example: `(query/key->opts [:posts {:limit 5}] {:base-url "https://api.com" :stale-time 5000})`

### Fetching Queries

#### Message: `[::query/fetch key opts]`

```clojure
(def posts-key [:posts {:_limit 5}])

(defmethod relm/update ::load-posts [state context _ _]
  [state context
   [[::relm/dispatch!
     [::query/fetch posts-key
      (query/key->opts posts-key
        {:base-url   "https://api.example.com"
         :stale-time 10000})]]]])
```

#### Query Options Reference

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `:url` | `string` | inferred | Target request URL. |
| `:method` | `keyword` | `:get` | HTTP method. |
| `:stale-time` | `integer` | `0` | Milliseconds data remains fresh. If fresh, fetch is skipped. |
| `:force?` | `boolean` | `false` | Bypasses stale checks and forces network fetch. |
| `:retries` | `integer` | `3` | Maximum automatic retry attempts on network error. |
| `:retry-delay` | `integer \| fn` | exponential | Delay in ms before retry attempt. |
| `:on-success` | `vector` | `nil` | Message dispatched on query success: `(conj on-success data key)`. |
| `:on-failure` | `vector` | `nil` | Message dispatched on query error: `(conj on-failure err key)`. |

### Mutations & Optimistic UI (`::query/mutate`)

Mutations update remote data and can optimistically update cached queries with rollback protection.

```clojure
(defmethod relm/update ::create-post [state context [_ new-post] _event]
  [state context
   [[::relm/dispatch!
     [::query/mutate [:posts]
      {:url        "https://api.example.com/posts"
       :method     :post
       :data       new-post
       ;; Optimistically prepend item to active cache query
       :on-mutate  [::query/set-query-data [:posts {:_limit 5}]
                    (fn [posts] (into [new-post] (or posts [])))]
       ;; Invalidate hierarchical prefix on settlement
       :on-settled (query/invalidate-hierarchical [:posts])}]]]])
```

#### Mutation Options Reference

| Option | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `:url` | `string` | Mutation endpoint URL. |
| `:method` | `keyword` | HTTP method (defaults to `:post`). |
| `:data` / `:body` | `any` | Request payload. |
| `:on-mutate` | `vector` | Message dispatched immediately for optimistic cache update. |
| `:on-success` | `vector` | Message dispatched after mutation succeeds. |
| `:on-failure` | `vector` | Message dispatched on mutation error. Automatically rolls back optimistic context snapshot. |
| `:on-settled` | `vector` | Message or invalidation dispatched on completion regardless of outcome. |

### Cache Invalidation Strategies

- **Exact match**: `(query/invalidate-exact [:posts {:_limit 5}])`
- **Hierarchical prefix**: `(query/invalidate-hierarchical [:posts])` — matches `[:posts]`, `[:posts 1]`, and `[:posts {:_limit 5}]`.
- **All queries**: `(query/invalidate-all)`
- **Predicate**: `(query/invalidate-predicate (fn [key query] ...))`

Options for invalidations:
- `{:refetch-active? true}` — Automatically triggers refetch for all currently rendered/active queries matching the pattern.

### Query View Query Helpers

- `(query/data context key & [default])`: Extract query data from context.
- `(query/loading? context key)`: True if first load is pending.
- `(query/fetching? context key)`: True if any network request is in-flight (including background revalidation).
- `(query/stale? context key & [stale-ms])`: True if cache is stale or missing.
- `(query/error context key)`: Returns query error map or nil.
- `(query/mutation-loading? context id)`: True if mutation is in-flight.
- `(query/mutation-error context id)`: Returns mutation error.

---

## 8. `relm.reitit` Reference

Namespace: `relm.reitit`

Provides client-side routing with Metosin Reitit and bidirectional synchronization with Relm's global context.

### Routing Architecture

When routing is started, `relm.reitit` listens to browser `popstate` events, matches current URL paths against the Reitit route table, and updates `context`:

```clojure
{:route         #reitit.core.Match{:template "/users/:id"
                                   :data     {:name :user :view UserView}
                                   :path-params {:id "42"}}
 :current-route :user
 :router        #reitit.core.Router{...}}
```

### Router Initialization

```clojure
(def routes
  [["/" {:name :home :view HomeView}]
   ["/posts" {:name :posts :view PostsView}]
   ["/posts/:id" {:name :post :view PostDetailView}]])

(def router (reitit.core/router routes))

(defn on-init [state context _args _event]
  [state context [[::relm/dispatch! [::relm.reitit/start router {:default-path "/"}]]]])
```

### Navigation Messages

- `[::relm.reitit/navigate-to "/posts/42"]` — Navigate to path.
- `[::relm.reitit/navigate-to :post {:id 42}]` — Navigate by route name and path params.
- `[::relm.reitit/navigate-to :posts nil {:sort "asc"}]` — Navigate with query params.
- `[::relm.reitit/replace-to target params query]` — Navigate replacing history entry.
- `[::relm.reitit/stop]` — Unregisters history listeners.

### Context Route Helpers

- `(relm.reitit/current-route context)`: Returns route name keyword (e.g. `:home`, `:posts`).
- `(relm.reitit/current-view context)`: Returns matched `:view` function/component.
- `(relm.reitit/current-match context)`: Returns full Reitit `Match` record.
- `(relm.reitit/current-path-params context)`: Map of path parameters (`{:id "42"}`).
- `(relm.reitit/current-query-params context)`: Map of query parameters.
- `(relm.reitit/path-for context route-name & [path-params query-params])`: Generates URL string.

---

## 9. `relm.devtools` Reference

Namespace: `relm.devtools`

Provides integration with the Redux DevTools browser extension, time travel, deterministic action replay, and browser console debugging.

### Connecting DevTools (`devtools/connect!`)

```clojure
(ns my-app.main
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.devtools :as devtools]
            [replicant.dom :as r]))

(devtools/connect!
  {:name            "Production Admin"
   :max-age         100
   :trace-effects?  true
   :log-to-console? true
   :collapsed?      true})

(r/set-dispatch! relm/dispatch!)
(relm/render! js/document.body AppRoot)
```

#### DevTools Configuration Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `:name` | `string` | `"Relm Application"` | Session name in Redux DevTools extension. |
| `:max-age` | `integer` | `50` | Maximum actions retained in history buffer. |
| `:trace-effects?` | `boolean` | `true` | Include side-effect vectors in action entries. |
| `:log-to-console?` | `boolean` | `false` | Pretty-print action dispatches and state diffs in browser console. |
| `:collapsed?` | `boolean` | `true` | Collapse console log groups. |

### Time Travel & History Manipulation

- `(devtools/jump-to! index)`: Restores app state to history index `index` without re-executing side effects.
- `(devtools/undo!)`: Steps backward by one action.
- `(devtools/redo!)`: Steps forward by one action.
- `(devtools/reset-to-initial!)`: Restores application state to initial connection baseline.
- `(devtools/commit!)`: Commits current state as the new baseline and purges history.
- `(devtools/toggle-action! index)`: Skips/unskips action at `index` and recomputes all subsequent states deterministically.

---

## 10. End-to-End Application Recipe

A complete working example combining `relm.core`, `relm.form`, `relm.query`, `relm.reitit`, and `relm.devtools`:

```clojure
(ns my-app.core
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.devtools :as devtools]
            [relm.form :as form]
            [relm.query :as query]
            [relm.reitit :as relm.reitit]
            [reitit.core :as reitit]
            [replicant.dom :as r]))

;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;; 1. Routing & Views
;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(def posts-query-key [:posts {:_limit 5}])

(defn posts-view [_state context]
  (let [posts     (query/data context posts-query-key [])
        loading?  (query/loading? context posts-query-key)
        fetching? (query/fetching? context posts-query-key)]
    [:div
     [:h2 "Posts List"]
     [:button {:disabled fetching?
               :on {:click [::query/fetch posts-query-key
                            (query/key->opts posts-query-key
                              {:base-url   "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com"
                               :stale-time 10000})]}}
      (if fetching? "Loading..." "Refresh Posts")]
     (when loading? [:p "Fetching posts from server..."])
     [:ul
      (for [{:keys [id title]} posts]
        [:li {:key id} title])]]))

(defn post-form-init [_context _args]
  {:form (form/create {:initial-values {:title "" :body ""}
                       :validators     {:title [(form/required "Title is required")]}})})

(defmethod relm/update ::save-post
  [state context [_ values] _event]
  (let [new-state (update state :form form/reset-form)]
    [new-state
     context
     [[::relm/dispatch!
       [::query/mutate [:posts]
        {:url        (query/key->url [:posts])
         :base-url   "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com"
         :data       values
         :on-settled (query/invalidate-hierarchical [:posts])
         :on-mutate  [::query/set-query-data posts-query-key
                      (fn [curr] (into [values] (or curr [])))]}]]]]))

(defn post-form-view [{:keys [form]} context]
  (let [title-err (form/error form :title true)
        mutation-loading? (query/mutation-loading? context [:posts])]
    [:div
     [:h2 "Create Post"]
     [:form (form/form-attrs form {:on {:submit [::form/submit form {:on-submit [::save-post]}]}})
      [:div
       [:label "Title: "]
       [:input (form/register form :title {:required "Title required"})]
       (when title-err [:span.error title-err])]
      [:div
       [:label "Body: "]
       [:textarea (form/register form :body {})]]
      [:button {:type "submit" :disabled mutation-loading?}
       (if mutation-loading? "Submitting..." "Create Post")]]]))

(def PostForm (relm/component {:component-id "post-form"
                               :init         post-form-init
                               :view         post-form-view}))

;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;; 2. Root Component & Router Bootstrap
;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(def routes
  [["/" {:name :posts :view posts-view}]
   ["/create" {:name :create :view (fn [_state context] [PostForm])}]])

(def router (reitit/router routes))

(defn root-view [state context]
  (let [view-fn (relm.reitit/current-view context)
        route   (relm.reitit/current-route context)]
    [:div.app-container
     [:header
      [:nav
       [:button {:on {:click [::relm.reitit/navigate-to "/"]}} "View Posts"]
       [:button {:on {:click [::relm.reitit/navigate-to "/create"]}} "New Post"]]]
     [:main
      (when view-fn (view-fn state context))]]))

(defn app-on-init [state context _args _event]
  [state context
   [[::relm/dispatch! [::relm.reitit/start router {:default-path "/"}]]
    [::relm/dispatch! [::query/fetch posts-query-key
                       (query/key->opts posts-query-key
                         {:base-url "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com"})]]]])

(def AppRoot
  (relm/component
    {:component-id "app-root"
     :on-init      app-on-init
     :view         root-view}))

;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;; 3. Application Start
;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(defn ^:export start! []
  (devtools/connect! {:name "Relm Full App" :trace-effects? true :log-to-console? true})
  (r/set-dispatch! relm/dispatch!)
  (relm/render! (js/document.getElementById "app") AppRoot))
```
